misprints.note: Acute instead of grave before a following word.
The headword is printed with a triple p.

uncertain.note: The first 'bägarn' looks like 'bägaru' in the scan. It is probably a worn n, since this face's n looks u-like elsewhere too (e.g. 'Kringgärdning'), so I transcribed it as bägarn.
The circumflexes on the line 'ρουν. γυρουν' sit at the very edge between the two image bands. Only their tops are visible, at the bottom of band 1.
